name: ColorFittings Carbon Fiber Display Case
title: ColorFittings Carbon Fiber Display Case
description:
The ColorFittings Carbon Fiber Display Case is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. Showcase the Original Colored AN Fittings with the official ColorFittings 7-Color Display Case. Designed for dealers, vendors, and performance shops, this premium shadow box features all seven of the signature anodized colors mounted against a high-gloss carbon fiber backing for a clean, motorsport-inspired presentation.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
